siegeSays.line: A woman, maybe 20s: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
🗣️ Ruby to Kathleen, by the fire: "Stone. We need 44 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The Lockpick stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (Big Big, Inspiration, The Heckler) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
The defenders met them at the treeline — nothing reached your bedroll.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
🗣️ Sam to Ruby, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 10,200 of 14,000 kcal."
Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)
Arturo came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

💬 Furaha pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Rafael Kim. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
◈ SYSTEM: "PALISADE: ONLINE. Pointy! The audience approves of pointy. Raiders will think twice — the ones that can think. Sleep easy, little ones. The walls are watching so you do not have to."
🍽️ Jorge lingers by the full pantry and laughs. "Full shelves, full bellies. Mending the palisade today — the fence won't fix itself."

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
